description: Links that show a spinner and navigate once a timer has run (450 ms, 1.2 s) are links: the timers the activation set are waited for, up to activationTimerMaxMs (2 s), and the navigation is seen. A link whose timer is due after that (6 s) showed its spinner and has not navigated yet: info, timerPending, never likely. A link that only shows a panel acts as a button, and a button that shows and hides a part of the page without aria-expanded is a disclosure that does not expose its state: neither sets a timer, and both are reported as before.
